units.source_text: 再这样紧张下去可受不了。

en.t: He could not bear going on in this state of tension.

units.source_text: 而且，他仔细一想，本来就没有堵住她嘴的必要。

en.t: Besides, when he thought it over carefully, there had been no need to gag her in the first place.

units.source_text: 那时，女人要是狂呼救命，反而会使那些家伙狼狈起来，或许能早些决出胜负来。

en.t: At that moment, if the woman had screamed wildly for help, it might actually have thrown those men into confusion and perhaps brought the matter to a quicker conclusion.
